estimate.method: Judge cost uses the observed $8.854735 for 129 release-grader batches. Mistral cost applies live catalog prices to the exact input, cache, and output token counts from one retained route check per task, multiplied by five. The route preflight reserves the mean cost of those three retained checks. Modal cost is unavailable and remains null.
estimate.official_single_call_upper_bound: Use the complete observed Oracle-stage spend. This is necessarily at least as large as any one of its nine serial judge calls.

gate_rule.entry: Live account and key balances must cover the complete known estimate plus 25 percent, with exact frozen model slugs and prices.
gate_rule.post_oracle: Record the first live balance after the accepted serial Oracle job, before route preflight.
gate_rule.official: After the route preflight, require the complete remaining official estimate plus 25 percent plus the entire observed Oracle-stage spend. Exact frozen slugs and prices must still match.

limitations: RewardKit 0.1.7 does not retain per-judge-call usage, so the complete observed Oracle-stage spend is used as a conservative upper bound for one call.
OpenRouter reservation behavior and hidden reasoning usage are not known before execution.
Modal cost is not included because a release-only dollar amount is unavailable.
